summary: A multi-select Combobox that offers a Create row for text that matches no tag, and adds the new tag to its options.
use: Free-form tagging where users pick existing tags or invent new ones inline.
spec: `options` starts with `design`, `backend`, `urgent` and `onCreate` appends the new value
`placeholder="Add tags"` and `searchPlaceholder="Search or create a tag"`
